routes.why: Admin backend may request front-end or back-end changes through the controlled apply-change route with backup and rollback.
routes.reply: I can treat this as an admin code-change request. Use the builder admin panel to apply it with a backup and rollback.

routes.why: Front requests may ask Synthia to write, but Synthia must route them into the writer loop; public requests cannot directly patch source.
routes.reply: I can turn this into a build request. Public requests stay in chat first; admin approval is needed before code is changed.

routes.why: Supplied projects and files enter through inboxes and must remain intact or be placed by manifest/rule before build.
routes.reply: I can import those files. Complete projects stay together. Loose files are sorted by clear rules, and unknown files go to review.

routes.why: GitHub changes affect the install and require admin review or explicit auto-pull configuration.
routes.reply: This is a GitHub or update request. Use GitHub Status, Pull Updates, Prepare Commit, or Roll Back from the admin dashboard.

routes.why: Conversation stays inside Synthia and LCM unless explicitly routed to writer/admin tools.
routes.reply: I am here. Tell me what you want to build, fix, upload, or check.
